articles.title: Manchester United Parts Ways with Manager Michael Carrick
articles.summary: The team has accumulated a mere eight points from ten games, placing them in the relegation zone.
articles.content: Manchester United has made the decision to part ways with manager Michael Carrick after their dismal start to the Premier League campaign. The team has accumulated a mere eight points from ten games, placing them in the relegation zone - an unprecedented position for a club of Manchester United's stature and history. Carrick, 45, had taken charge on an interim basis following Ruben Amorim's departure in January and went on to lead the side to a respectable third-place finish last season. However, his team's performances have plummeted since he was handed a two-year permanent deal, with their struggles attributed in part to questionable recruitment during the summer transfer window. Manchester United has confirmed that Carrick is no longer at the helm, citing a need for change in order to meet their ambitions. The tumultuous tenure of Manchester United's manager has come to an abrupt end, with the club citing a need for change in order to meet their ambitions. Carrick's struggles to maintain discipline within the team were evident in his decision to drop captain Bruno Fernandes following a public criticism of his tactics. This move was made after a disappointing 4-1 loss at Como, a Champions League debutant that proved to be a stern test for United. The incident highlighted Carrick's difficulties in managing player dissent and maintaining cohesion within the squad. The final straw came on Sunday, when Manchester United drew 4-4 against Aston Villa in a chaotic match. Despite his claims that he would not walk away from the club, it appears that Carrick's fate was sealed after this game. The decision to act swiftly was likely motivated by the team's poor performance, with just three wins from 15 games across all competitions. Behind-the-scenes meetings have been taking place to determine the future of Manchester United, and a key gathering occurred on Wednesday in Monaco. Co-owner Jim Ratcliffe, chief executive Omar Berrada, and director of football Jason Wilcox were among those present at this meeting, where Carrick's future was likely discussed. Pochettino has emerged as the leading candidate to succeed Carrick, with his extensive experience in the Premier League making him an attractive option. His previous spells at Southampton, Tottenham, Chelsea, and Paris Saint-Germain have provided valuable insight into top-flight management, and he is now set to bring his expertise to Old Trafford. Manchester United's recent managerial upheaval has sparked reactions from fans and supporters' groups alike. In a heartfelt tribute to departing manager Michael Carrick, defender Harry Maguire took to Instagram to express his admiration for the former midfielder. "Will always be a legend," Maguire posted, accompanied by a simple yet sincere message of respect. The departure of Carrick marks another significant managerial change at Old Trafford since Sir Alex Ferguson's retirement in 2013. This is the seventh time the club has parted ways with a permanent manager under the Glazer family's ownership. The Manchester United Supporters' Trust (MUST) has weighed in on the situation, criticizing the club's leadership for prioritizing financial interests over sporting success. The MUST statement highlights the debt burden imposed by the Glazers and questions the impact of INEOS's investment, which promised to bring about a new era of excellence but has instead led to repeated changes in football leadership. United will face Liverpool at Anfield on November 22, marking a highly anticipated matchup between two fierce rivals. articles.title: Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur Soft Opening Marks New Luxury Hotel Arrival
articles.summary: The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has opened its doors in Kuala Lumpur, offering travelers a new luxury experience with access to main attractions and shopping districts.
articles.content: A new luxury hotel has opened its doors in Kuala Lumpur, offering travelers an unparalleled experience. The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur, a flagship property from Hilton's portfolio, is now welcoming guests after a recent soft opening. Located in the heart of the city's Golden Triangle district, the hotel occupies the site of the former Hotel Istana, a storied landmark that has been transformed into a modern oasis. This prime location allows visitors to easily access the city's main attractions and shopping districts. The hotel boasts an impressive range of amenities, including palatial suites that cater to the needs of discerning travelers. These spacious accommodations are complemented by a selection of bars and restaurants, featuring culinary offerings from renowned chefs like Jean-Georges Vongerichten and Garima Arora. One of the standout features of the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is its commitment to luxury and relaxation. The hotel will soon be home to Malaysia's first La Prairie spa, providing guests with a serene retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The outdoor pool area offers a tranquil escape, perfect for lounging in the tropical heat. With its stunning design and exceptional service, the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is poised to become a favorite among travelers seeking an unforgettable experience. As I had the opportunity to stay at the hotel within days of its opening, I can attest that it's already making a significant impression on visitors. While not all amenities were available during my visit, the initial glimpse was promising, and I look forward to returning for a more comprehensive review in the future. The hotel's exterior design may blend seamlessly into its surroundings, but once inside, guests are greeted by a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The art deco style is cleverly infused with Asian motifs and Islamic artworks from the owner's collection, creating an unique aesthetic. In particular, the bronze and glass clock in Peacock Alley is a striking feature that draws inspiration from centuries-old astrolabes at the Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia. This attention to detail reflects the hotel's commitment to showcasing local culture. Located in Kuala Lumpur's prestigious Golden Triangle district, the Waldorf Astoria is perfectly positioned for exploring the city. The hotel is within walking distance of several upscale malls and the famous food street of Jalan Alor, making it an ideal base for dining and shopping excursions. Guests can easily reach the hotel from Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL) via a 60-minute drive. While taxis are available at around $60 each way, a more affordable option is to hail a ride through the Grab app, which costs between $20-$30 in each direction. Parking facilities at the hotel include complimentary valet and self-parking services, ensuring guests have convenient access to their vehicles. With 268 suites spread across 23 stories, the hotel feels spacious without being overwhelming. The culinary options available within the hotel are impressive, with seven bars and restaurants to choose from. These include a modern take on the brand's signature Peacock Alley lobby lounge, as well as a vinyl album-inspired cocktail bar and several celebrity chef eateries. Each suite at the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur spans at least 80 square meters (861 square feet), making them generously sized. The decor, designed by Deboss Collective, draws inspiration from traditional Malay construction and crafts, incorporating natural stone, timber, woven textiles, and wooden furnishings to create a modern urban aesthetic that feels like a contemporary take on the traditional rumah kampung, or village house. The expansive windows in the rooms offer breathtaking views of the city skyline and the lush grounds surrounding the hotel, bathing the space in natural light. Inspired by traditional Malaysian craftsmanship, the intricate carpet patterns evoke a sense of history and cultural heritage, while vibrant accent walls pay homage to the colorful shophouses still standing in parts of the city. The spacious suite I occupied was surprisingly large, featuring an enormous living area that included a 65-inch flatscreen television and a breakfast table doubling as a work desk thanks to a panel of conveniently placed plugs. In the separate bedroom, a king-size bed was dressed with crisp white sheets adorned with a subtle "WA embroidery, subtly reinforcing the hotel's brand identity. The walls on either side of the bed were adorned with a terete theme reminiscent of the bamboo stalks commonly found in gardens throughout the city, adding an organic touch to the space. A second 55-inch flatscreen hung above the bed, providing ample entertainment options for guests. The bathroom was a serene oasis, featuring predominantly white marble flooring and geometric patterns, while the darker-hued countertops added a touch of sophistication. The Waldorf Astoria in Kuala Lumpur boasts an impressive lobby lounge called Peacock Alley, a nod to its New York City counterpart. Located at the hotel's entrance, this grand space features high ceilings, sculptural marble columns, and dramatic chandeliers that add to its upscale ambiance. Seating areas are thoughtfully designed to feel both homey and sophisticated, inviting guests to linger over a drink or snack. The lounge offers an array of options, including a smash burger priced at $22 and Malaysian nasi goreng for $17. Adjacent to the lobby, Istana is the hotel's all-day dining restaurant, named after its predecessor that once occupied this spot. This eatery serves up an extensive breakfast buffet featuring both Western and Asian dishes, catering to diverse tastes. Dining options abound in this Waldorf Astoria property, with a focus on seasonal ingredients at ABC Kitchens KL and The Bar by JG. Jean-Georges Vongerichten's farm-to-table concept is evident in the menu, which highlights fresh fruits and vegetables. Guests can start their day with breakfast or cap off an evening with dessert, such as the durian treat served with coconut cream and a palm sugar compote for $12. This sweet indulgence is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth. Located near the entrance of ABC Kitchens KL, there's a casual area with a cocktail bar and small plates available, providing a relaxed atmosphere for guests to unwind. The fourth floor of the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has a hidden gem waiting to be discovered - Coda, a sophisticated lounge that exudes an air of exclusivity. Glossy dark stone surfaces and emerald-green velvet chairs and banquettes create a swanky ambiance, while the menu of craft cocktails inspired by vinyl albums adds to the allure. These libations are not just any ordinary drinks; each one is carefully crafted to evoke the essence of its corresponding album, making for a truly unique experience. Located in a secluded area, Coda feels like a secret hideaway that only those in the know can access, adding to its mystique and charm. The menu itself is an interesting concept, with drinks named after iconic albums such as Dark Side of the Moon" and "Thriller", among others. Amenities at the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur are plentiful, including a well-equipped fitness center with Technogym cardio machines and free weights for guests to stay active during their stay. The hotel's pool area is another highlight, featuring shaded loungers where guests can relax and take in the breathtaking views of the surrounding cityscape, including the iconic Merdeka 118 skyscraper. One of the most anticipated features of the hotel is its La Prairie spa, which will be Malaysia's first and only outlet when it opens in mid-November. This luxurious spa promises to offer a range of treatments and amenities, including vitality pools, a hammam, and herbal steam rooms for guests to indulge in and rejuvenate. Throughout the public areas of the hotel, guests can admire an impressive collection of Islamic art from the hotel owner's private collection, adding a touch of cultural sophistication to the overall ambiance. Service at the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has been consistently excellent, with staff providing a warm welcome and attentive service without being overly intrusive or pushy. Booking a room at the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is relatively straightforward, with nightly rates starting from around $520 or 100,000 Hilton Honors points, depending on availability. Additionally, guests can take advantage of perks such as late checkout and a complimentary breakfast for two. The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has made significant efforts to ensure accessibility throughout its public areas. Strategically placed elevators with wheelchair-height buttons and ramps allow guests with mobility impairments to navigate the hotel easily. Wide pathways also contribute to a barrier-free environment. Accessible rooms in the King Urban Deluxe category offer specialized features for guests who require assistance. These accommodations come equipped with audio and visual alarms, an automatic door closer, and a wheelchair-height door viewer for added convenience. The hotel's luxurious suites are substantial, justifying the cost of 100,000 points per night. Considering the high price point in Kuala Lumpur, this option might be worth considering for those seeking a premium experience. Upon completion of its restaurants and spa, the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is expected to become one of the city's most popular luxury hotels, offering an unparalleled level of service and amenities. articles.title: Clinical trials for Synchron's brain implant technology put on hold due to performance issues
articles.summary: The company is undergoing significant restructuring efforts, including job cuts and a scaling back of operations in New York.
articles.content: A Brooklyn-based startup has put its clinical trials on hold due to issues with the performance of its brain implant technology. The company, a rival to Elon Musk's Neuralink, is also undergoing significant restructuring efforts, including job cuts and a scaling back of operations in New York while expanding its presence in San Diego to support development of an entirely new device. Synchron has been at the forefront of brain-computer interface (BCI) technology, which enables people to control digital devices by reading brain signals and translating them into commands. This innovative approach aims to revolutionize the way we interact with technology. The company's Stentrode implant is a minimally invasive device that doesn't require brain surgery or resting in the brain itself. Instead, it is inserted into the jugular vein at the base of the neck, guided by a catheter to sit atop the motor cortex of the brain. Ten volunteers across the US and Australia have successfully tested the first-generation Stentrode, which allowed them to perform tasks such as sending emails, browsing the internet, shopping online, and even controlling devices like Amazon Alexa and Apple's iPad and Vision Pro with their thoughts. The clinical trials of Synchron's brain implant, known as the Stentrode, have been put on hold due to performance issues with the device. According to sources close to the trials, the problem lies not with the Stentrode itself but rather with its ability to function as intended. This decision was made by Synchron, the company behind the technology, and is not a result of any safety concerns related to the device. Synchron has stated that it will upgrade the entire system, including the lead design and manufacturing process, which will be brought in-house. This move aims to address the performance issues and ensure the Stentrode meets the required standards. The company's decision to pause the trials is not a reflection of any safety concerns, but rather an effort to refine the technology before moving forward with the next phase of testing. Synchron has assured that it will continue to support participants who have already received the Stentrode implant and provide them with ongoing care throughout their lifetime. Synchron's brain-computer interface technology has shown great promise, but recent performance issues have prompted a pause in its clinical trials. The company remains optimistic about the potential of its Stentrode implant to become a leading treatment option for neurological disorders. In a bid to address the technical problems, Synchron is expanding its operations in San Diego, with multiple job openings listed on its website and LinkedIn page. These positions include roles for electrical and mechanical engineers, microchip designers, and materials scientists, who will work together to design and manufacture an upgraded version of the implant's lead. The upgraded device will also feature a new component that goes beyond the blood vessels, according to Synchron's website. This separate device is still shrouded in mystery, but it appears to be an innovative step forward in brain-computer interface technology. The company has hinted at developing a more complex and natural system for controlling devices. The rapid growth of the brain-computer interface field has attracted significant investment from top venture capital firms. Synchron's valuation stands at nearly $1 billion following its recent funding round, which brought in $200 million. The company is backed by influential investors including Khosla Ventures and the venture firms associated with Bill Gates and Jeff Bezos. Neuralink, another prominent player in the field, has been valued as high as $42 billion in secondary market transactions this summer. Synchron's early struggles with its implant have not dampened investor enthusiasm for brain-computer interface technology, which is seen as a promising area of research and development. The coin-sized brain implant developed by Synchron has been experiencing technical difficulties since its early trials began. One of the implant's users, Arbaugh, experienced a setback when several of the wires came out of his brain, resulting in a loss of control over the cursor. This incident highlights the challenges that still need to be overcome before these devices can be widely used. Despite the setbacks, the development of brain-computer interfaces is gaining momentum due to advancements in artificial intelligence. AI models have proven capable of reading brain patterns more accurately and quickly than traditional algorithms, which has sparked significant investment in the field. Companies like Merge Labs, cofounded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, are emerging with substantial funding and collaborations with leading tech companies, underscoring the potential for breakthroughs in this area. articles.title: Sneaker Collection Exceeds 400 Pairs After Over a Decade of Collecting
articles.summary: A sneaker collector has amassed over 400 pairs in their collection after more than a decade of collecting, with some shoes obtained through effort or at significant cost.
articles.content: A staggering number of sneakers has accumulated in my collection over more than a decade of collecting, exceeding any reasonable measure and totaling around 400 pairs at last count. The sheer quantity can be overwhelming, making it difficult to determine which shoes truly deserve a place in the collection. Some have been obtained through considerable effort, such as entering numerous raffles for the JJJJound x New Balance 990v3 or waiting overnight for the Sacai x Nike VaporWaffle. Others have been acquired at a significant cost, including paying resale prices for the Gucci x Adidas Gazelle. With so many options to choose from, it's essential to assess which shoes are genuinely worthy of being part of the collection. A shoe can be both intriguing and impractical to wear, whereas another might seem unremarkable but ultimately prove to be a versatile addition that complements most outfits. If I had to rebuild my collection from scratch, I would focus on acquiring a core group of essential pairs. This process involves evaluating which shoes are genuinely deserving of a place in the collection rather than simply accumulating more and more sneakers. In an ideal scenario, I would pay closer attention to the second category of shoes, those that seem almost too obvious but ultimately prove to be highly useful additions to one's wardrobe. To start this rebuilding process, I've identified 21 pairs from Foot Locker's selection as key contenders for re-entry into my collection. These include basketball shoes prized for their shape and history, everyday running shoes, and low-profile options to add variety. These 21 pairs are a mix of well-known brands and iconic models that have stood the test of time. The Air Jordan 1's timeless design makes it a staple in many sneaker collections. Its ability to complement simple outfits is a major draw for those who want a versatile shoe that won't go out of style quickly. The Nike Air Force 1 '07 has been around since 1982, and its classic design still holds up today. The leather basketball low-top features perforations across the toe, giving it a distinctive look that's both functional and stylish. One reason to own an Air Force 1 is its ability to pair well with loose-fitting jeans. The shoe's weight and beefy sole give it presence without overpowering the outfit. A fresh white Air Force 1 would be an excellent choice for those who want a simple, timeless look that won't require much thought. The Nike Dunk Low has undergone many design changes over the years, but its original college basketball roots are still evident in its color-blocking layout. The 'Sanded Purple' model is a great example of how this feature can add visual interest to an outfit without overwhelming it. When choosing a pair of Dunks, consider opting for one that features bold colors or unique design elements. This will give you the flexibility to create multiple outfits with a single shoe, rather than getting stuck in a rut with a more neutral option. The Adidas Superstar II has a rich history, dating back to 1986 when it was popularized by the song "My Adidas." However, its distinctive shape and chunky design make it a standout choice for those who want a statement piece that won't blend into the background. While many sneaker enthusiasts might be drawn to the original Superstar, the Shelltoe model is a more stylish option. Its extra padding gives it a bulkier look that's perfect for pairing under straight jeans, where the toe can be fully appreciated. The Nike Air Jordan 1 Low OG has been around since the debut of the Air Jordan line in 1985. This black-and-red pair features X graphics at the heel, adding an extra layer of visual interest to an already iconic design. For those who want a more understated take on the classic Air Jordan look, there's no shortage of options available. Whether it's a bold colorway or a unique design element, each pair offers something new and exciting that can be paired with everything from jeans and tees to dresses and skirts. The design of some sneakers can be altered to better fit specific needs or preferences. In the case of a certain model, removing the tall collar allows for more space around the ankle and a less bulky appearance. This change in design makes the shoe suitable for wearing with shorts or slightly shorter pants. The familiar colorblocking of a particular brand's Jordan line is still present, even if the overall look has been modified. The addition of this new version to a collection can be justified by its unique features. There are many ways to achieve a mesh running-shoe look, but some designs stand out more than others. One such design is the New Balance 990v6, which was first released in 2022. This shoe boasts cushioned comfort and has been popularized through various marketing campaigns. The original campaign for this model featured Action Bronson, who later released his own colorways. The 990 family of shoes dates back to 1982, but the sixth generation features new technology such as FuelCell cushioning. This design allows for a more seamless look, with suede overlays flowing across the mesh without the usual midfoot saddle. The practical benefits of this design can be seen both in its appearance and underfoot comfort. The 990v6 is suitable for days with a lot of walking due to its comfortable design and good looks. This makes it a worthwhile investment, even if comfort is not the only justification. The shoe's design has been praised for its unique features and technical details. Its layered mesh and synthetic overlays work together well, making it a standout in its category. Some shoes are designed with specific needs in mind, such as the Asics Gel-Kayano 14. This retro mesh running shoe was first released in 2008 and won Runner's World's International Editor's Choice award that same year. The OG 2008 Gel-Kayano 14 was designed by someone other than Toshikazu Kayano, a fact that may be of interest to sneaker enthusiasts. The layered mesh and synthetic overlays on this shoe work together well, with Gel cushioning underneath providing additional support. A key feature of the Gel-Kayano 14 is its construction, which showcases the contrast between different materials. This is particularly evident in the 'Graphite Grey' colorway, where the Gel cushioning can be seen right underneath. The New Balance 1906R was also released in 2022 and features a retro mesh running shoe design. It shares sole technology with other models such as the 2002R and 860v2. This shoe is designed for those who want to see all the technical details, with open mesh, curvy overlays, and segmented cushioning around the heel providing plenty of visual interest. The white, silver, and black colorways showcase this design particularly well. The 1906R's upper looks more put-together compared to other models that share its sole technology. This makes it a great option for those who want to see all the little details in their shoes. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 is a cushioned mesh running shoe that was first released in 2011, but it didn't gain its cult following until about a decade later. The shoe's design features open mesh, overlapping panels, and plastic caging that becomes particularly noticeable on certain colorways like 'Metallic Silver'. This combination of elements gives the Zoom Vomero 5 a unique look that sets it apart from other running shoes. The Zoom Air cushioning in the Vomero 5 also makes it a practical choice for everyday wear. Its ability to provide comfort and support during long days makes it an attractive option for those who want a shoe that can keep up with their active lifestyle. For those who value detail, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 is a great choice. The mesh panels and plastic caging give it a level of sophistication that makes it easy to pair with jeans and a plain sweater. This versatility is one of the reasons why the Vomero 5 has become so popular among sneaker enthusiasts. In addition to its design, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 also boasts impressive performance capabilities. Its cushioning system provides excellent shock absorption, making it ideal for runners who need a shoe that can handle high-impact activities. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 is another retro mesh running shoe that has gained popularity in recent years. First released in 2010, the Omni 9 features a classic design with mesh panels and supporting structure that gives it a nostalgic feel. One of the key features of the Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 is its ProGrid cushioning system, which provides excellent shock absorption and support. This makes it an attractive option for runners who need a shoe that can handle high-impact activities without sacrificing comfort. The white and pink version of the Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 showcases the layers of mesh and supporting structure that give the shoe its unique look. Its retro design gives it a level of character that sets it apart from more modern running shoes, making it an attractive option for those who want to add some variety to their collection. The Nike P-6000 is a mesh sneaker that draws inspiration from archive Nike designs. First released in 2019, the P-6000 combines elements from the Pegasus 25 and Pegasus 2006 to create a unique look that's both retro and modern. The Nike P-6000 features a simple yet effective design that makes it easy to wear with jeans or dress pants. Its mesh upper gives it a lightweight feel that's perfect for everyday wear, making it an attractive option for those who want a shoe that can keep up with their active lifestyle without breaking the bank. The Salomon XT-6 is a trail running shoe that was first released in 2013. Its design features a reinforced upper, Quicklace system, and lugged outsole that make it ideal for serious trail runners. One of the key features of the Salomon XT-6 is its Quicklace system, which provides excellent support and stability during high-impact activities. The shoe's reinforced upper also gives it a level of durability that makes it perfect for long-distance running on rugged terrain. The versatility of sneakers is one aspect that makes them so appealing to collectors. When choosing a shoe to pair with cargo pants or wider-leg pants, the close-fitting upper and outdoor construction of certain models can be particularly beneficial. For instance, a shoe with these features can easily complement denim, olive, and navy-colored clothing, making it an excellent addition to any wardrobe. Slim sneakers are also ideal for those who prefer jeans that taper or have a shorter hem, as they sit closer to the foot and provide a more streamlined look. The Adidas Samba is one such model that deserves consideration in black leather, its slim shape setting it apart from other designs. Its roots date back to soccer shoes designed specifically for icy fields in 1950, but what earns it a place among these recommendations is its sleek silhouette. Collectors often strive to avoid purchasing items that are too common or widely available, and the Samba's unique design makes it an attractive choice for those looking to add some variety to their collection. Its slim shape also makes it an excellent option after wearing chunky basketball shoes, providing a welcome change of pace. The versatility of a simple silhouette is undeniable, especially when paired with casual wear like faded denim or dark pants. A black and white color scheme can add an effortless touch to any outfit, making it easy to style without much thought. Puma's Suede has been a staple in the sneaker world since its inception in 1968, and its classic design remains timeless. The shoe's low-top profile makes it suitable for everyday wear, while its basketball roots give it a rugged edge that appeals to fans of streetwear. This particular model would be an excellent addition to any collection. The Suede's soft upper and signature Formstrip provide a subtle texture and visual interest without overwhelming the senses. Its understated design also means it won't compete with other statement pieces in your wardrobe, making it perfect for days when you want to keep things simple. When it comes to chunky sneakers, there are several options that can add depth and visual appeal to an outfit. The Nike Air Max 95 is a popular choice, thanks to its layered upper design that gives the shoe a unique texture and character. Its bold design concept was inspired by human anatomy, translating ribs, muscle fibers, and a spine into a running shoe. The Air Max 95's chunky silhouette makes it suitable for wider pants and heavier layers, while its layered side panels add depth to even the most minimalist color combinations. This shoe has enough personality to stand on its own, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking to mix things up in their wardrobe. articles.content: Microsoft's latest Windows update has hit a snag for some users, causing installation failures on Windows 11 PCs. The issue arises when attempting to install this week's November Patch Tuesday update, which is designated KB5132061. Microsoft has acknowledged the problem and provided an explanation on its support page. Some Windows 11 users who installed the November preview update released on October 28 may encounter a glitch when trying to install the actual November update, released on November 10. This can lead to repeated attempts at installation or error codes such as 0x80070306, 0x800f0989, or 0x800f0993. Microsoft's own testing has confirmed the problem, with one of its Windows 11 virtual machines experiencing the installation failure after installing the preview update. Microsoft has assured users that any affected PCs should receive repairs within a specified timeframe. To ensure timely repair, it's essential to have your PC connected to the internet and set up to receive updates via Windows Update. Navigate to Settings and select Windows Update to check for available updates. If you find the November update, known as 2026-11 Security Update (KB5132061) (26300.9974), is available again, choose it to install and the process should proceed smoothly. This step may resolve any issues related to the installation failure. Microsoft typically releases monthly Windows updates in two phases, with the first phase being an optional preview update. The November preview update was released on October 28, labeled KB5127936. This non-security update introduced feature changes, including a customizable right-click menu and Cloud rebuild option. The support page for troubleshooting problems updating Windows offers additional guidance if you encounter any errors during the installation process. If you're experiencing issues with installing the November Windows update on your PC, there are a few things to consider. The mandatory Patch Tuesday update, which includes both security patches and non-security changes, was released on November 10 as part of the KB5132061 update. The preview updates, designed for IT administrators and software testers who want an early look at upcoming features, may contain bugs and aren't always fully tested before being made available through Windows Update. However, it's worth noting that these updates can be installed by anyone, regardless of their technical expertise or role. In some cases, conflicts between the preview and Patch Tuesday updates can arise, as seen with the November KB5132061 update, which required Microsoft to resolve an incompatibility issue before proceeding with its rollout. articles.summary: Potential presidential candidates are prioritizing pragmatism over internal party divisions ahead of the 2028 election.
articles.content: Democrats' midterm victories have sparked a renewed push for unity among potential presidential contenders, who argue that the party's internal divisions must take a backseat ahead of 2028. In the wake of their party's sweeping gains, several likely White House hopefuls have made it clear that they want to focus on delivering results rather than engaging in ideological battles. Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro recently noted that voters are increasingly frustrated with politics and are looking for pragmatists who can deliver tangible outcomes. "What was clear, no matter where you go," Shapiro said at a recent conference hosted by Crooked Media, is that people are fed up. He emphasized that voters are not focused on whether candidates identify as left, right, or center, but rather want to see action. Michigan Senator Elissa Slotkin has a straightforward assessment of how elected officials should be spending their time. Instead of engaging in internal party politics over progressive versus moderate labels, they should focus on delivering results for their constituents. Slotkin's own campaign experience is instructive here, as she backed progressive Abdul El-Sayed despite being a moderate herself. The shift away from labeling is not limited to Slotkin; many rising Democratic stars are adopting an ethos that prioritizes getting things done over ideological purity. This approach is exemplified by the "get stuff done" mantra, which emphasizes pragmatism and effectiveness over partisan labels. By embracing this mindset, Democrats hope to sidestep the perennial debate over electability. Last week's election results have emboldened Democrats to rebrand themselves in a more inclusive way. Progressives were once seen as unelectable, but their successes have shattered that myth, while centrists are also being recognized for their ability to win votes. As the party looks ahead to 2028, many are seeking to avoid traditional labels and appeal to voters who care about pocketbook issues rather than ideological purity. The Democratic Party's 2028 presidential contenders are shifting their rhetoric away from ideological purity tests and toward a focus on authenticity and pocketbook issues. This change in tone reflects a recognition that voters are increasingly skeptical of traditional party labels. Democratic strategists point out that the party has been criticized for imposing strict ideological litmus tests during the 2020 primary, which led to divisions among candidates and voters alike. As a result, many potential contenders are now seeking to appeal to a broader range of voters by emphasizing their personal authenticity. Advisers close to these contenders note that there is a growing sense of disillusionment with the government's ability to deliver for working-class people. This sentiment is reflected in postelection memos from potential presidential candidates, which highlight the need for a more effective and responsive government. The Democratic Party's move towards selecting a single candidate to run for the White House has sparked concerns about proxy battles between different factions within the party. This development comes as the party shifts from running multiple candidates in diverse districts to concentrating on a single candidate with a broader appeal. As a result, various groups are vying for influence and setting their own agendas, which could lead to more intense infighting in the months ahead. Meanwhile, centrist group Welcome is promoting a moderate approach, suggesting that embracing a more middle-of-the-road stance can be a winning formula in a crowded field of candidates. A moderate approach is gaining traction among potential Democratic presidential candidates, with some emphasizing the importance of not being labeled as strictly left or right wing. Khanna's comments highlight a growing trend where centrist voices are urging their peers to adopt a more nuanced stance, allowing them to advocate for their vision without being tied to a specific ideological label. articles.title: Nvidia's CEO Steps Down Amid Controversy Over Alleged Affair
articles.summary: Jensen Huang, Colette Kress, Harvey C. Jones
articles.content: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position at the helm of the $4 trillion chip giant, amidst controversy surrounding an alleged affair with a Chinese data center executive. The company has appointed Colette Kress, its chief financial officer, as interim CEO to oversee daily operations while a search for a permanent successor is underway. This move comes just days after news broke about Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data center company that buys chips from Nvidia. The removal of Huang as CEO follows the revelation over the weekend that Nvidia's board of directors had launched an investigation into whether he was being targeted by foreign intelligence. This decision marks a significant shift for the company, which has been at the forefront of the AI boom and has previously held the title of world's largest chip maker by market capitalization. As part of its search for a permanent CEO, Nvidia will consider both internal and external candidates, according to an official press release. Harvey C. Jones, a former CEO of Synopsis, has been appointed as Nvidia's first-ever chair of the board of directors to oversee this process. The controversy surrounding Huang's alleged affair with Alice Huang has raised concerns about potential national security implications, given her reported ties to China's spying operations and her work in data centers that sell computing power to Chinese AI labs. The US government's efforts to restrict China's access to advanced technology have been ongoing for years, but reports indicate that some companies are still finding ways to circumvent these controls. According to recent findings, a network of Chinese firms has been involved in the sale of $7.5 billion worth of chips from the US to China. This illicit trade involves banned US-made components being smuggled into China, highlighting the ongoing challenges in enforcing export restrictions. A separate controversy surrounding Nvidia's leadership has also come to light, with reports emerging of an affair between CEO Jensen Huang and one of his direct subordinates at the company. The revelation has sparked concerns about potential conflicts of interest and the impact on Nvidia's operations. As the AI chip manufacturer continues to navigate these challenges, its reputation and financial stability are under increasing scrutiny. The news of Nvidia's leadership issues has sent shockwaves through the company's stock price, with shares plummeting since October. Despite opening at $150 per share on Thursday morning, down from nearly $174 on Wednesday, the decline in value reflects growing concerns about the industry's future prospects. The AI sector has faced increasing pressure due to shifting government policies and a changing regulatory landscape. Nvidia has taken steps to address these issues by hiring an external investigator to look into the company's dealings. Joon H. Kim, a former acting US attorney for the Southern District of New York, will lead the independent probe alongside his law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. This move is seen as an attempt to restore confidence in Nvidia's governance and operations. The investigation into Nvidia's activities comes at a critical time for the AI industry, which has been facing growing regulatory pressure. The company's data centers, powered by its cutting-edge chips, are central to this ecosystem. As the sector continues to evolve, it remains to be seen how these developments will impact Nvidia's future prospects and the broader AI landscape. The sudden departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has sent shockwaves through the tech industry, raising concerns about the future of artificial intelligence on Wall Street. Huang's resignation comes at a time when markets are already bearish on AI stocks following significant gains by Democrats in Congress and key data center states such as Texas and Ohio. This shift in political landscape has led to increased scrutiny of companies involved in the development and deployment of AI technologies. As Nvidia's leader, Huang was a vocal advocate for the growth of AI, providing the necessary infrastructure for its widespread adoption through the company's powerful GPUs and supercomputers. His close relationship with President Donald Trump, including a high-profile phone call during a podcast taping, has also drawn attention to the intersection of politics and tech. The scandal surrounding Huang's resignation is likely to have far-reaching implications for Nvidia and its partners, including data center operators and AI developers who have benefited from the company's financial support. The fallout may even impact other companies in the sector that rely on Nvidia's technology and investment. As the industry grapples with this leadership crisis, analysts are warning of a potential "stress test" for the entire AI boom. Stephanie Balaouras, vice president at Forrester, notes that Huang's resignation is about more than just succession at Nvidia, but rather a broader challenge to the sector's prospects. The sudden resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has sparked concerns about the company's stability and its impact on the broader tech industry. The departure raises questions about the future of the sector, particularly in regards to artificial intelligence (AI) innovation. If Nvidia struggles to maintain stability under new leadership, it could further indicate the fragility of the AI market, according to analysts. articles.summary: NVIDIA has announced that Jensen Huang is no longer its CEO, with Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO.
articles.content: NVIDIA's board of directors has announced a sudden change at the top, as Jensen Huang is no longer CEO of the company. The move comes after Huang held the position since NVIDIA's founding, and he will also be giving up his seat on the board. According to an official statement from the company, Huang's resignation is effective immediately, with Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO. Kress currently serves as executive vice president and chief financial officer at NVIDIA. NVIDIA has stated that Kress will continue in her current roles while serving as interim CEO until a permanent successor is named. The board of directors has begun searching for a new CEO, considering both internal and external candidates. Harvey Jones, who was appointed chair of the board, said that Colette Kress has helped lead NVIDIA through significant growth and has a deep understanding of the company's business operations. The investigation into Jensen Huang's behavior is ongoing, with multiple parties involved in scrutinizing his actions as CEO of NVIDIA. The company's board had already announced an inquiry after Huang admitted to having a relationship with a former tech executive who was accused of being a Chinese intelligence asset. Details about the affair have been slowly coming to light, including reports that Huang also had a romantic relationship with an NVIDIA executive in his direct line of management. This revelation has sparked further questions about the company's internal dynamics and potential conflicts of interest. The implications of these allegations are far-reaching, given NVIDIA's significant role in the AI industry. The company's transformation from a 3D graphics specialist to a leading player in artificial intelligence is a testament to Huang's leadership over the past three decades. As NVIDIA's stock price has skyrocketed in recent years, so too has Huang's public profile. He has become a prominent figure at industry events, often appearing alongside other tech CEOs such as Mark Zuckerberg and Satya Nadella. Huang's views on AI have been shaped by his experience at the helm of NVIDIA, which he co-founded in 1993. While some experts are sounding alarm bells about the risks of superintelligence, Huang has taken a more optimistic stance on the technology. The debate surrounding regulation of the AI industry is complex and multifaceted, with various stakeholders weighing in on the need for greater oversight. Huang's position on this issue reflects his confidence in the benefits of unbridled innovation. Huang's association with President Trump has been a notable one, with both men appearing together in public on several occasions. This included a recent trip to China, where Huang was part of a delegation of tech leaders accompanying the president. The president was asked about these revelations and offered his assessment of Huang's character, describing him as "an honorable guy" who likely had an explanation for his actions. Despite this endorsement, Huang has faced significant backlash in light of recent developments. NVIDIA employees received a memo from their departing CEO earlier this week, in which he expressed regret for his actions and reaffirmed his commitment to the company's mission and values.
